01_retired_gent: a tall, slim East Asian man in his seventies with short neat silver hair and round wire glasses, a tan belted trench coat open over a charcoal knit sweater, brown wool trousers, brown leather oxford shoes, and a grey tweed flat cap.
02_sundress_mom: a plus-size Black woman in her thirties with a big natural afro puff hairstyle and gold hoop earrings, a bright mustard-yellow floral sundress under a cropped light-wash denim jacket, white canvas sneakers, and a small tan crossbody bag on a strap.
03_construction_worker: a short, stocky Latino man in his forties with a thick black mustache, a white hard hat, a high-visibility orange safety vest over a red and black plaid flannel shirt, dusty blue work jeans, and tan leather work boots.
04_teen_skater: a lanky South Asian teenage boy with messy black hair, an oversized purple hoodie, baggy khaki cargo shorts, white crew socks, chunky black high-top sneakers, a black backpack on both shoulders, and over-ear headphones resting around his neck.
05_executive: an athletic white woman in her forties with a sleek platinum-blonde bob, a tailored navy pantsuit with a white silk blouse, black pointed-toe heels, a slim gold watch, and a black leather laptop shoulder bag.
06_lumberjack_hipster: a heavyset white man in his thirties with a full ginger beard and a man bun under a mustard-yellow knit beanie, a red and green buffalo-check flannel shirt, a black puffer vest, black slim jeans, and brown lace-up leather boots.
07_hijabi_student: a young Middle Eastern woman in her twenties wearing a soft blush-pink hijab, oversized tortoiseshell sunglasses, a long olive-green trench coat, a cream turtleneck, wide-leg light-blue jeans, and chunky white sneakers.
08_dapper_elder: an elderly Black man in his late seventies with an entirely original face that does not resemble any real person or celebrity: a round full face with soft cheeks, clean-shaven except for a thin neat grey pencil mustache, short cropped white hair, and thin gold-rimmed rectangular glasses, of medium height with a slight rounded belly. He wears a chocolate-brown tweed three-piece suit with a waistcoat, a burgundy bow tie, a brown felt fedora hat, and polished oxblood brogues.
09_marathon_runner: a tall, muscular Pacific Islander man in his twenties with curly dark hair tied back, a fitted teal running tank top, black running shorts over grey compression tights, bright neon-orange running shoes, and a black sports watch.
10_punk_artist: a petite Southeast Asian woman in her twenties with a pastel pink chin-length bob and bangs, an oversized black leather biker jacket with silver studs over a white band-style t-shirt with an abstract print, a red tartan pleated skirt over black leggings, and chunky black platform combat boots.
